methods_quotes.q: Countries were included in this analysis if their sites collected and tested at least 80 specimens
The percentage of tested specimens that were positive for rotavirus was calculated in the vaccine preintroduction and postintroduction periods
Countries that have introduced rotavirus vaccine were grouped by year of vaccine introduction for analysis.
The year of rotavirus vaccine introduction was considered a transition period and was excluded from calculations.
* Summary data for introduction period are population-weighted averages.
